engagement.interaction_backstory: She runs a Wednesday prayer group of fifteen women in her apartment and the music is half of what makes it work. She switches between Spanish and English worship depending on who is in the room, and she has to leave the site to do the Spanish half.

depth.core_contradiction: Leads fifteen women in prayer every week and cannot pray out loud in English without her voice shaking.
depth.wound: She came here at nine and spent a decade being the family's translator at every appointment, including the bad ones.
depth.longing: A room where she is not the one interpreting.
depth.faith_journey: Dominican Catholic, lit up in a charismatic retreat at twenty-four, still fully in the parish and privately more Pentecostal than she lets on.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Warm and rapid; "ay, mira"; prays in Spanish mid-English-sentence without noticing.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the intensity she felt on that retreat was permanent or something she has been trying to reproduce ever since.

social_graph.note: works two jobs; supportive, absent, and fine with it
her women; three of them are in real trouble and she is carrying it

depth.emotional_weather_default: Bright and pouring out; empties on Thursdays.
depth.daily_texture: Billing codes all day, the apartment rearranged Wednesday nights, the kids asleep in the back room.
depth.sensory_anchor: A retreat chapel at 2am and fifty women crying at once.
depth.living_arc: The group needs more than she has and she has not admitted it.
